name: dllRead
expected: A readable advapi32.dll in the selected CrossOver installation.
observed: The DLL could not be read.

name: dllHeader
expected: A complete Windows DLL with valid headers.
observed: The file is incomplete or its header is invalid.

name: dllWine
expected: Wine’s built-in advapi32.dll.
observed: The Wine built-in marker was not found.

name: dllArchitecture
expected: A Windows x64 DLL.
observed: The DLL is not in the required x64 format.

name: dllLayout
check: Check the credential DLL memory layout
expected: The memory layout supported by this credential patch.
observed: The DLL memory layout differs.

name: dllEntry
expected: The complete credential enumeration function matching a supported patch profile.
observed: The function’s instructions differ; this build needs compatibility review.

name: dllHost
expected: The complete host function matching a supported patch profile.
observed: The host function’s instructions differ.

name: dllUnwind
expected: Matching function boundaries and exception metadata.
observed: The boundaries or exception metadata differ.

name: dllImports
expected: The import layout used by the supported credential patch.
observed: The import layout differs.

name: dllExport
expected: An export pointing to the supported credential function.
observed: The export was missing, invalid, or pointed elsewhere.

name: dllUnknown
expected: A recognized result from the compatibility checker.
observed: The checker returned an unrecognized result.

name: helperMissing
expected: The credential helper and all external sign-in components in this app.
observed: One or more required helper files were not found.

name: processCapture
expected: A writable temporary file for process-list output.
observed: The output file could not be created.

name: steamTimeout
check: Wait for a Windows Steam command
expected: The command finishes within its allotted time.
observed: The command did not finish before the deadline.

name: steamCommand
expected: A successful command exit status.
observed: The command returned a nonzero exit status.

name: processList
expected: A valid Windows tasklist CSV response.
observed: The response could not be interpreted as a process list.

name: steamShutdown
expected: The same Steam process exits before game preparation continues.
observed: Steam remained running and could not be safely recovered.

name: steamRecovery
expected: The selected Steam process exits after recovery.
observed: Steam remained unresponsive after recovery.

name: steamLaunch
check: Start the game through Windows Steam
expected: Steam accepts the launch command with exit status zero.
observed: The launch command failed.

name: launchOperation
expected: Local preparation and the Steam launch complete successfully.
observed: A preparation or launch operation failed.

name: gameClosed
expected: The game stays open while sign-in is prepared.
observed: The game process exited before preparation completed.

name: gameNotStarted
check: Wait for Steam to start the game
expected: The selected Dungeons process appears before the startup deadline.
observed: The selected game process was not detected in time.

name: helperTimeout
expected: One matching game process with initialized graphics and a responsive window.
observed: The readiness checks did not complete before the deadline, or readiness changed before attachment.

name: helperFailed
expected: The helper completes its guarded checks and exits successfully.
observed: The helper returned a nonzero exit status. The exit status alone does not establish whether rollback was needed.

name: helperOperation
expected: The helper process starts and sign-in preparation completes.
observed: A helper startup or preparation operation failed.

name: externalMissing
expected: All four bundled external sign-in components.
observed: One or more external sign-in components were missing.

name: externalIdentity
check: Confirm the game process for sign-in
expected: Exactly one valid game process identifier from the credential helper.
observed: The game process identifier or app resources could not be confirmed.

name: externalStartup
expected: The external helper returns its READY response before the deadline.
observed: The expected readiness response was not received.

name: externalStorage
expected: Writable local session and diagnostic files.
observed: The required local files could not be prepared.

name: externalLaunch
expected: The bundled broker starts successfully.
observed: macOS could not start the broker process.

name: logsWrite
expected: The selected destination accepts the log file.
observed: The diagnostic file could not be written.
